title: Timeline on Review of Community Dispute Management Framework
what_it_is: Timeline on Review of Community Dispute Management Framework

sections.label: Community Dispute Management Framework review
sections.summary: MCCY leads an inter-agency committee that regularly reviews the Community Dispute Management Framework to update measures such as referral protocols, mediation and legislative recourse.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: MCCY leads an inter-agency committee that regularly reviews the Community Dispute Management Framework or CDMF that Mr Yip has referred to, to update and improve measures, such as the referral protocol amongst frontline agencies, mediation and, of course, also legislative recourse.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Our guiding principles continue to be to strengthen neighbourliness to minimise disputes upstream as far as possible; encourage mediation between neighbours to mend relations as far as possible; and, finally, as a measure of last resort, legal recourse for cases which may be intransigent.

sections.label: CMC mediation training and referrals
sections.summary: The CMC trains officers and over 1,500 Grassroots Leaders in mediation, enhances referral protocols for earlier escalation, and visits residents who fail to respond to mediation invitations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The CMC works to equip these officers with mediation skills so that they, who encounter the neighbours and the disagreements first-hand, will be able to have some skills to try to resolve that as a measure of first resort.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: More than 1,500 Grassroots Leaders have been trained in the past five years on basic mediation as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Again, on the premise that these are persons who are on the ground, they deal with neighbours, they interact with neighbours on a daily basis and they will be the first responders to any issue that might arise.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: We have also enhanced the referral protocols in the context of when a case can be escalated to CMC so that CMC, with its expertise, can intervene upfront and earlier.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: So, these are some steps that we take, together with CMC.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: I would add also – I forgot to mention this earlier – that CMC also, on occasions, visits residents who fail to respond to a mediation invitation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: On occasions when CMC asseses that this case is suitable for mediation and one side has failed to respond, CMC officers and mediators also visit the resident concerned to try to persuade that person to come for mediation.

sections.label: Decentralising mediation venue
sections.summary: The idea is to decentralise the venue of mediation as far as possible and find a location suitable for both parties.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The idea really is to decentralise the venue of mediation as far as possible and find a location that is suitable for both parties.
